exactEquality.obligation: Preserve public names, signatures, conformances, Codable shape, units, frames, synchronous calling behavior, nil results, and error cases exactly.
Preserve UT equality and hashing, captured Delta T identity, accepted-date and mutable-state behavior, event identity and ordering, and success, nil, or error status exactly.
Preserve coefficient bits, term order, qualification masks, and offline artifact provenance exactly unless a separately reviewed numerical change replaces them.
Preserve exact within-build cache replay, caller time metadata, signed-zero key behavior, and position fields shared by paired position and state APIs.

Require exact parsed JSON equality while the Swift comparison runner still calls the frozen C engine. A native Swift candidate is judged by the exact contracts above plus regression and independent-accuracy evidence, not by cross-implementation bit identity.

numericalRegression.obligation: Reject non-finite values; compare periodic angles after wrapping; allow 1e-8 degrees for angles, 1e-8/15 hours for right ascension, max(1e-12 AU, abs(reference) * 1e-12) for distances, and 1e-14 for illumination against frozen engine fixtures.
Keep the existing rise/set and full-moon regression fixtures within 0.01 seconds without regenerating their expected values to make a candidate pass.

Keep non-lunar ecliptic longitude and latitude rates within 1e-9 degrees per day and distance rates within 1e-12 AU per day. Lunar rates use 5e-7 degrees per day and 1e-10 AU per day because the shipped lunar state uses a finite-difference stencil.
Keep polynomial positions and derivatives within max(1e-12 AU, abs(reference) * 1e-12) of the compensated full model; qualification uses 2.5e-13 AU and AU/day screening.

independentAccuracy.obligation: Match the checked-in JPL Horizons geocentric ICRF samples within 1 arcminute for the Sun, Moon, and inner planets and 1.5 arcminutes for Uranus and Neptune.
Do not broaden the published plus-or-minus 1 arcminute claim without new independent evidence. Regression agreement with the C engine does not establish this limit.

derivedBounds.obligation: Re-derive the solar-altitude bound from shipped Swift expressions. Sample agreement and the current C-derived certificate do not certify a rewritten expression.
